projects.name: PortfolioHub
projects.description: Career platform in one place: portfolio, CV import and generation, job tracking, recruiter outreach and LinkedIn publishing, with AI features on top.
projects.context: Also the API that serves this site.
items: Resume Studio — CV import from PDF and DOCX with heuristic parsing and an LLM fallback; export to Markdown, LaTeX and PDF
Outreach — template-first bulk applications: one AI call per template, plain substitution per contact, drafts sent through the user's Gmail
Integrations — GitHub repository import, scheduled LinkedIn posts, Gmail and Google Calendar sync

projects.name: AutoGTM
projects.description: Autonomous go-to-market platform: a B2B company database with AI enrichment, and agents that run outbound end to end from a single domain.
projects.context: Four surfaces on one design system: marketing site, programmatic SEO engine, public agent demo and the authenticated app.
items: Agent pipeline — researches the company, maps competitors, splits the market into campaigns, finds buyers, writes and sends each email, handles replies
Programmatic SEO — 640 generated pages
Runs on a laptop — without MongoDB and Redis the API falls back to an in-memory store behind the same interface

projects.name: Swift Core ERP
projects.description: Business management system covering sales and cash sessions, inventory, finance, HR and payroll, service orders and an audit log.
items: Sales — multiple payment methods, cash sessions and automatic invoices
Inventory — stock movements and low-stock alerts
Finance and HR — bank accounts, budgets, departments and payroll

projects.name: Sereia Studio
projects.description: Booking and management app for a beauty studio: services, team, clients and appointments, with public online booking.
projects.context: React SPA and Express API in one monorepo. Availability and double-booking rules are enforced on the server.
items: Real time — every change emits a Socket.IO event, so open schedules update across devices
Auth — short-lived access token in memory and a rotating httpOnly refresh cookie
Hardening — Helmet, strict CORS, rate limiting, NoSQL sanitisation and Zod validation on every input

projects.name: RAG against the machine
projects.description: Retrieval-augmented generation over the vLLM codebase: ask a question in plain English, get back the exact file and character range, and an answer grounded in those excerpts.
projects.context: BM25 retrieval over 30,665 chunks from 1,830 files. Qwen3-0.6B writes the answer from the retrieved excerpts and nothing else.
items: Recall@5 of 0.870 on documentation questions and 0.879 on code questions, against required 0.80 and 0.50
Full index build in 17 s; 199 questions retrieved in 0.6 s
Language-aware chunking for Python and Markdown

projects.name: Pacman
projects.description: Pac-Man recreated in Python with a clean project structure and a deployable build.

projects.name: Call-me-Maybe
projects.description: Function calling from scratch: constrained decoding makes a language model's output valid JSON every time, with no ML libraries.

projects.name: Fly-in
projects.description: Routing a fleet of drones through a zone network with capacity limits, using prioritised space-time A* and a reservation table.
items: Search over (node, time) pairs, so temporal collisions are avoided by construction
Global reservation table for zone and connection occupancy
Exact distance heuristic pre-computed with a backward BFS from the end hub

projects.name: Libft
projects.description: Parts of the C standard library reimplemented from scratch.

projects.name: Industrial Defect Detection
projects.description: Visual inspection of industrial products on the MVTec AD dataset, in four phases that each answer a different question about a defect.
items: CNN — is the product normal or defective?
Convolutional autoencoder — how far is this image from a normal reconstruction?
U-Net — where exactly is the defect, pixel by pixel?
ResNet50 transfer learning — do pretrained ImageNet features separate good from defective?
